guardrail_notes.detail: The statement of operations, cash flow statement and supplemental page print no prior-year comparative column; the second column on those pages is the single month ended October 31, 2026, which was not spread. Only the balance sheet has a comparative column (December 31, 2025), which is the prior fiscal year end rather than the same date a year earlier.

Note 1 on page 5 is a one-month rollforward of capitalised software (opening balance, additions, amortisation, closing balance); none of its rows were spread as the template has no line for them, and its closing balance matches the balance sheet line already reported.
The pack prints no SaaS metrics, so the SaaS lines were left out.
No stock-based compensation memo line is printed anywhere in the pack.

The document is a single-page bank statement for October 1 to October 31, 2026, not a set of financial statements. Only the two bank summary totals were reported, as at the October 31, 2026 statement date.
The summary table prints no column header, so the section heading 'Summary' is given as the column header.
No units phrase is printed; figures are shown in whole dollars.

The restricted total includes an escrow collateral account (ending 9002) that was opened on October 14, 2026 under an escrow arrangement. The collateral account ending 9001 is pledged under the venture loan agreement.

This document is a monthly MRR report, not a financial statement pack. Only the SaaS metric lines are reported. The figures are point-in-time month-end metrics as of October 31, 2026, not ten-month fiscal year-to-date amounts.
No prior-year comparative column is printed, so no comparative cells are reported.
The MRR bridge (opening MRR, new customers, expansion, contraction, churn, closing MRR) and the trailing six months table have no template lines and were not spread.
Net new ARR is labelled as being for the month only. The template line may expect a different measurement period.

unshown_text.text: The Schedule 1 calculation of Unrestricted Cash on page two includes cash held in an escrow collateral account opened during the month; escrow collateral cash may not qualify as unrestricted, so the reported cash and runway figures may warrant review.
The requirement for Revenue to Plan on page one wraps across two lines in the summary table.

Unrestricted cash headroom slipped from {{fact:3ce160dd-3a08-48c9-bb27-ba864fb42ea9}} to {{fact:9c317a78-fb2b-4ef1-8d0b-99c44a0f3974}}, then fell sharply to {{fact:2906f61f-4b39-46a4-964a-c9a108fc19cf}} in October. Cash of {{fact:a280aeb3-37d8-4e61-b9b6-7bd220b149f0}} still clears the {{fact:2e0970d5-4f5d-4491-bf43-4b2ff6fc2d2e}} floor. The runway decline points the same way, suggesting cash burn picked up.

Runway headroom fell from {{fact:bc6196a2-5e4a-405b-a31a-3507c574581f}} to {{fact:ab609b05-cc7f-49e3-885d-d5d2cabfd20f}} and then to {{fact:c088cb13-c166-4468-ba16-365e40e93a7c}}, with the steepest drop in October. Runway of {{fact:ccb823a4-d9d6-4a9a-ad4e-4b352a725383}} months is still well above the {{fact:b922f3af-45bc-42e7-abf0-39ee86c2a5e1}}-month minimum. The October drop mirrors the falling cash balance, so both covenants reflect the same liquidity pressure.

Revenue headroom has been essentially flat, at {{fact:018378f7-0ac5-4927-a5d6-7fed9f650a7f}}, {{fact:8ecd74bb-c12a-4cbe-b597-e72a4aa38448}} and {{fact:6bee3bb8-0aa3-4731-a413-f092a6711030}}. Revenue is running at {{fact:7afe03cb-986c-438b-a580-887f6533735b}} of plan against an {{fact:5801d833-6a61-43d7-a541-8526ce1751ac}} floor. This suggests the cash and runway declines stem from spending or working capital rather than weaker sales.
